content.text:
I fixed the pricing page on phones. The three plan cards (Starter, Pro, Team) were squeezed into three narrow columns side by side, which pushed the page wider than the screen. I measured the page at 390px, a typical phone width. Before the fix it was 486px wide; after, it fits.

The cause was that the `.plans` grid wasn't in the mobile layout rules in `site/css/pages.css`, so it kept its three-column layout on small screens. I added `.plans` to the rule that already stacks the other grids (`.faq`, `.bundles` and so on) at 720px and below. It's a one-line change, uncommitted.

- **Visual tests:** all 12 pass, with no baseline changes. The approved pricing phone baseline already showed the stacked layout, so the fix matches what you had before.
- **Functional tests:** all 16 pass.
- **Comparison table:** it still scrolls sideways inside its own box on phones. That is how it was built, so I left it alone.

I didn't check the layout on a real phone, only in headless Chromium at phone size.

STATUS: DONE
